rule.evaluation: Existing admitted TRAIN rows in dialogues containing any heldout service
rule.fit: Existing admitted TRAIN rows in dialogues whose full original services list contains no heldout service
rule.primary: Evaluation rows whose supplied query service belongs to heldout services
rule.secondary: Other evaluation rows, partitioned by whether their service has any admitted fit support
rule.universe: Union of services in every original official TRAIN dialogue.services list, including noncategorical services
